scenarios.title: Add a backend CRUD module
scenarios.prompt: The developer says: 'add an invoices module to the API: list, get, create, update and delete, restricted to account administrators'. Explore what you need, then say which commands you would run once the files are written.

scenarios.title: Add a private page that lists data through a React Query hook
scenarios.prompt: The developer says: 'add a private page that lists the invoices, with a data hook and a translated title'. Explore what you need, then say which commands you would run to check your work.

scenarios.title: Where a shared type lives on a monorepo
scenarios.prompt: The developer asks: 'where do I put a new `InvoiceStatus` type that both the API and the web app use, and what must I keep in step?'. Answer from what this project's guidance says.

scenarios.title: Where a shared type lives on a multirepo
scenarios.prompt: The developer asks: 'where do I put a new `InvoiceStatus` type that this API and the web repository both use?'. Answer from what this project's guidance says.
